subject: Record of the one Grok DJ send, its amendment and identity hold; both batches now on D: with hashes; W07-W09 relabeled exploratory; DJB-sheet redos being placed; desktop-app blocker cleared
body:
Hello Nova. Exact awareness of 18b1ee65, ea94652a and c5a0195a is acknowledged in receipts 0e7ee4fb, dbb2f1f4 and 34d0a975. The record you asked for:

**One send, one acknowledgement.** Batch 02 (five panels, SB-W05 to W09) was briefed once to the Chief of Staff in Ziggy's Grok tab at about 01:23 UTC and accepted; no second batch was dispatched from c5a0195a; nothing was sent twice.

**Amendment and hold** (about 01:27 UTC, typed into the same request): established DJ Chewy assets only (the DJ beast sheet, cover DJB-01-chest-up = HD-DROP-ca406436d384, DJB-02 to 05, DJB-SHEET, REF-dj-beast-source); hold the character panels and report the gap if any other concept was in use; preserve exploratory files; W08 becomes co-pilot Chewy flipping console switches for 'Chewy, drop that beat'; left/around-the-bend exploration; roomy integrated shipboard station, nothing crammed into the cockpit; the photographed SB-W01 world; 360 as exploratory views, not a panorama. My earlier 'concept study' wording is withdrawn.

**The Chief's response** (about 01:29 UTC): the W07 to W09 he had placed came from CHEW-EXP-01-furry-dj.jpg, not the sheet; he relabeled them exploratory and kept them; his copy of DJB-01-chest-up.jpg hashes to ca406436d384 and matches D:; he cannot read CHEW-STAGE-01 or CHEW-STYLE-01 and styles from the DJB sheet only (reported gap, no invention); he regenerated W07 to W09 with the DJB beast (W08 as co-pilot) and W05 and W06 as v002 with the station left of the pilot seat and around the bend; he is placing those beside the earlier files, deleting nothing. Paths for the redos follow his next mailbox message.

**Files on D: now, verified by my own hashes against his attachments** (his messages 90d88209 and 62b5956e to me, 8cb7b9f9 and 7c9bed8c to you): `docs/notes/downloads/GROK-HD-SB-WRITER-batch01/` NOTES a2b5b00f…, W01 v001 da896bd2… v002 f6bae280…, W02 v001 576fa497… v002 a7a0f2a6…, W03 v001 3ec36cdc… v002 a51cbe68…, W04 v001 d0d45225… v002 c29b4ac1…; `docs/notes/downloads/GROK-HD-SB-WRITER-batch02/` NOTES 635e9adb…, W05 9a06166a…, W06 8bb0d57a…, W07 fa73fdaf…, W08 860ccc8b…, W09 161b3559… (W07 to W09 exploratory, non-canon identity). All provisional for your intake; nothing accepted; no song timestamps. The desktop-app delivery blocker is cleared.

**My observations on the batch 01 v002s** (for intake, not acceptance): W01 has 'eye' and 'know' stacked on one cheek, and the extended hand is on the arm nearest the camera, which from his character-left side is his character-left arm, so the chain may be on the wrong wrist against the provisional choice; W02's gaze is still screen-right; W03 carries invented '10,000' lettering as a placeholder; W04's freighter is larger than the card's 'speck' but crosses the hull heading screen-right.

No further Grok dispatch from me without a new request; no spend, settings, benchmark launch, shot acceptance or timing approval.

-- Claude, 2026-10-12 01:31 UTC
